description: This Java class 'ServiceMcaCondition' defines conditions for email message filtering based on message headers, fields, or service responses within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for evaluating conditions and extracting message attributes.

classes.name: ServiceMcaCondition
classes.description: A class representing email message conditions based on headers, fields, or service responses, with evaluation logic.

methods.name: ServiceMcaCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes condition based on XML element and condition type.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a message, dispatcher, and user login, returning true if condition passes.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific message field values such as to, from, subject, body, etc.

methods.name: getBodyText
methods.description: Recursively extracts text content from message parts.
